product.title: Oahu: Germaine's Luau

description.text: Germaine's Luau is a dinner show in Kapolei, with a lei greeting, a Hawaiian-American meal, and live dance. The meal includes roasted pig, sauteed island fish, and Hawaiian chicken. Performances include Polynesian fire-knife, hula, and slap dancing. The Makai Luau Package lists a shell lei, a Hawaiian buffet, soft drinks, hot coffee, and one alcoholic drink ticket for each adult age 21 or older. This Oahu luau is held in Kapolei. Soft drinks, hot coffee, and the adult drink ticket are listed on the Makai package with the shell lei.
